candidates.description: This feature vector represents terms and abbreviations associated with medical practitioners, physicians, and academic doctoral titles.
This feature vector represents concepts of comparison, equivalence, and relational similarity across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens related to philosophy, its prefixes, and academic titles.
This vector represents world-renowned universities and institutions of higher education.
This feature activates on words, subwords, and abbreviations starting with the letters "Sc" or "esc".
These tokens represent standard two-letter abbreviations or codes used in various technical, legal, or organizational taxonomies.
These tokens represent adjectives and modifiers indicating attributes, quantities, or statuses, predominantly in Spanish.
This feature vector represents common English action verbs denoting existence, relations, and decisions.
This feature vector represents subword suffixes and stems commonly found in Romance-language and English vocabulary words.
These tokens represent Spanish prepositions used to indicate spatial, temporal, or logical relationships.
